hotel_name: Tms Residency - Hotel In Dwarka Delhi

positive_snippets: The room services and the staff here are very co-operative and kind. Whatever is required once you ask the staff they immediately respond to it. The rooms and washroom are decent. Also the food here is very tasty and good portion. TMS residency is a good option to stay in Dwarka sector 7.

I had an incredible stay with these people and the staff was extremely polite and co operative with us . The residency gives a feel of home to the city and to all the people having doubts , this hotel is a couple freindly too.
Do check it out if you are in the city.
Special thanks to Gaurav for helping us out and for his behaviour

One of the best budget-friendly stays near the airport for families. All essential standard facilities like air conditioning, geyser, and other basic amenities are well provided. Food can be ordered directly from the property, so there is no need to go anywhere else. The food quality was excellent and truly A1.
